NEW POWER SUPPLY BOARD Early STARGATE games had a one-piece D-8359 Power Supply Board Assembly. In ROBOTRON and tater STARGATE games, this assembly has been superseded by the new 0-8474 Power Board and outboard heat sink assembly C-8807. The new board features crowbar over-voltage protection on the +12VDC and +5VDC regulated outputs. NEW TRANSFORMER On upright and cabaret-mode! games, a new power transformer with 8 primary and 12 secondary terminals (part no. 5610-09658) has also been substituted for the old transformer with 8 primary and 9 secondary terminals (part no. 5610-09535). The new transformer includes a 12.6V center-tapped secondary. Secondary termina! 20 and center-tap termina! 19 provide 6.3VAC general illumination power to pins 14 and 15 of plug 4P1. Cocktail table-model games continue to use a third power transformer with 6 primary and 9 secondary terminals (part no. 5610-09629).
